'''Gideon Na'al''' was the son of [[Voren Na'al/Legends|Voren Na'al]] and [[Rivoche Tarkin]], named after his mother's father, [[Gideon Tarkin]]. Na'al co-wrote the thesis ''[[Star Maps and Scripts: The Rakata Connection]]'', along with [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Henrietya Antilles]]. The work focused on how archeological discoveries linked many contemporary writing systems to those used by the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]].
